name: Shorter Writings of a Catholic
desc: Four shorter pieces Newman published as a Catholic: Cathedra Sempiterna, a short Latin-titled note on the See of Peter (1867); On Consulting the Faithful in Matters of Doctrine, from the Rambler of 1859; Five Letters to his nephew John Rickards Mozley (1875), in defence of the Catholic position; and On the Inspiration of Scripture, the Nineteenth Century essays of 1884.
desc_pt: Quatro escritos menores que Newman publicou como católico: Cathedra Sempiterna, breve nota sobre a Sé de Pedro (1867); Sobre a Consulta aos Fiéis em Matéria de Doutrina, do Rambler de 1859; Cinco Cartas ao sobrinho John Rickards Mozley (1875), em defesa da posição católica; e Sobre a Inspiração da Escritura, os ensaios do Nineteenth Century de 1884.
editor: John Henry Newman (Newman Reader transcriptions of the Rambler, the Nineteenth Century and the Contemporary Review texts)
edition: Cathedra Sempiterna (Dublin Review/Weekly Register 1867); On Consulting the Faithful in Matters of Doctrine (Rambler, July 1859); Five Letters to J. R. Mozley (Contemporary Review, Sept. 1899); On the Inspiration of Scripture (Nineteenth Century, Feb. and May 1884), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
note: Each piece is its own Newman Reader page. The index URL above is the first page; the others are miscellaneous/jrmozley.html, miscellaneous/scripture.html and rambler/consulting.html.
